filename.description: The name of the file containing the test cases

apiKeySetupFuncNames.description: The names of the functions on {@link TestApi} that should be called to set up llm keys

retrieverName.description: If the test should use a retriever other than the default "c3DocumentationV6"

suffix.description: The suffix used to set the REA configs via {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.Config#setReaConfigsBySuffix}

extractionConfigName.description: If specified, the extraction step will be enabled and performed with the specified config

usePgVectorRetriever.description: If the test should use Genai.Retriever.PgVector

retrieverOverride.description: If the test should use the given retriever instead of preconfigured one

doNotTruncateCallLog.description: For when we want to preserve text already written to the call log, do not truncate any existing file.

extractorMetadataFormat.description: If the extractor should add metadata

contextualQAMetadataFormat.description: If the contextual question answerer should add metadata

rerankerConfigName.description: If specified, reranking will be enabled and performed with the specified config

useAttribution.description: If the attribution framework should be used.

useAttributionWithCorroboration.description: If the attribution with corroboration framework should be used.

doNotUseMocking.description: Don't enable LLM mocking for this call
